title: Finite-origin comparison descends to common-stage internal Hom
statement:
theorem internal_hom_comparison_exists (B : Duality D l hl Ω X) :
    ∃ permitted : ∀ K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X,
      commonStageHomPairs l Ω X (op K, B.omega),
      Nonempty (B.duality.dual ≅ homDual l Ω X B.omega permitted)

proof.text: Use allPairs to supply the permitted-pair family. The explicit component construction gives an isomorphism at each literal object and naturality for every finite-stage arrow. The scalar-extension lemma gives naturality along each isoToStage. For an arbitrary morphism, choose one finite representative and factor it into the source isoToStage, an included finite-stage arrow, and the inverse target isoToStage. Derive the inverse square by cancelling the mapped isomorphism; compose the three squares. NatIso.ofComponents packages these components and the proved naturality into the required natural isomorphism.
